blocks.html: Every smile is beautiful in its own unique way. Enhance the natural beauty of your smile with comprehensive dental care that ensures your smile stays healthy for a lifetime. At Wolf Family Dentistry in La Porte, IN, our team offers friendly dental care, and you are always treated like a member of our family.

By using the latest technology, we provide patients with outstanding quality of care. We help you maintain your smile with comprehensive general dentistry services designed to prevent and treat dental health issues. Restore the function and beauty of your smile with cosmetic and restorative treatments such as tooth-colored fillings, teeth whitening, and more. Our goal is to help you feel confident in your smile!

It’s All About the Patient Experience

Each day, we strive to build meaningful provider-patient relationships and create a caring environment where our patients feel at ease. We want you to enter and leave our office with a smile! We take the time to talk with you and explain any dental issues you may be having as well as any treatment we recommend. By providing you with the resources, support, and guidance you need, we help you achieve your goals for your smile.

about-us.title: Family Dentist in La Porte, IN | Wolf Family Dentistry
about-us.description: Creating meaningful relationships with patients while providing with the highest level of care is our mission at Wolf Family Dentistry in La Porte, IN. Call us!

blocks.html: About Wolf Family Dentistry
blocks.heading: About Wolf Family Dentistry

blocks.html:
Our History

Dr. Renee Wolf knew from a young age that she wanted to be a doctor—her father was a heart surgeon. However, Dr. Wolf wanted to be able to have more interaction with patients than surgery allows for. This desire to build relationships with her patients led her to dentistry. She enjoys seeing her patients every six months, watching children grow up, and becoming friends with those she treats. She began her practice, Wolf Family Dentistry, in 1988 in La Porte, IN. She has many patients that have been with her since the beginning, and she considers herself lucky to call them her dear friends.
blocks.heading: Our History

blocks.html: Contact Us Today

Our Team

We have a full staff of kind, compassionate women who have all been a part of our patient care team for 10 to 20 years. We all work to develop warm and friendly relationships with our patients and to make them feel well-cared-for during their time in our office. Through ongoing continuing education and training we maintain excellence in our skills and we utilize the latest technology, materials, and procedures. Dr. Wolf and her staff educate patients using digital radiographs, intraoral images, and models.

We are proud to have received the People’s Choice Award for Best Dentist in La Porte County. This was voted on by the readers of the local newspaper, the LaPorte Herald Argus.
blocks.heading: Our Team

blocks.html: FAQs
blocks.heading: FAQs

blocks.html:
What preventive dental services do you offer to help maintain oral health?

At Wolf Family Dentistry, we emphasize preventative care through regular professional dental cleanings—typically recommended twice a year—using ultrasonic scalers (cavitron) for efficient and comfortable plaque and tartar removal. We also provide digital radiography (x-rays) that deliver clearer images with up to 90% less radiation than traditional methods, allowing for early detection of decay, gum disease, and other oral issues. Additionally, patients can benefit from custom night guards for teeth grinding and custom athletic mouthguards for sports protection, along with periodontal treatments like scaling and root planing to treat and prevent gum disease.

Can Wolf Family Dentistry help with TMJ-related jaw tension or headaches?

Yes! For patients suffering from TMJ disorders or bruxism (teeth grinding) that manifest as jaw tension or headaches, we offer Botox injections. This treatment can alleviate symptoms by reducing muscle clenching and tension, especially when traditional therapies haven’t provided relief.

What cosmetic and restorative treatments are available to improve my smile?

Wolf Family Dentistry provides extensive cosmetic and restorative services to restore both appearance and function. These include:

  • Teeth Whitening: To combat discoloration from beverages, aging, or medications.
  • Hybrid Dentures: Full arch implant-supported bridges that offer long-lasting results for patients needing full reconstruction.
  • Tooth-Colored Restorations: High-quality zirconia inlays, onlays, crowns, and implant restorations made from digital impressions with 3D scanning.
  • Dentures: Options include fixed-custom removable dentures, implant-retained fixed dentures, and partials—all crafted using 3D technology for precise fitting and comfort.

How do you ensure restorations look natural and fit comfortably?

We use advanced digital impression techniques with a 3D scanner to ensure precisely tailored restorations. These scans are sent to a lab for fabrication of durable, custom zirconia restorations—built for seamless integration, comfort, and longevity.

What technology do you use to minimize radiation exposure during dental x-rays?

Wolf Family Dentistry employs digital radiography, which reduces radiation exposure by up to 90% compared to traditional film x-rays, while providing instantly viewable, high-resolution images to better diagnose dental issues.

What should a new patient expect during their first appointment?

New patients can expect a warm, supportive experience focused on comfort and education. A thorough exam will assess oral health and include any necessary diagnostics. We encourage completing patient registration forms ahead of time (available online) to streamline your visit. Plus, our staff can assist in contacting your insurance provider to verify coverage.

Where are you located, and what are your contact details and hours?

Wolf Family Dentistry is located at:
 3550 W Johnson Rd, La Porte, IN 46350
 Phone: 219-362-3730
 Fax: 219-324-4273
 Email: wolffamilydentistry@live.com
 Office Hours:

  • Monday & Tuesday: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
  • Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Thursday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM

How do you provide patient education and what is the office atmosphere like?

Our team fosters meaningful provider-patient relationships through honest, clear communication. We explain diagnoses and treatment options in an understandable way, empowering patients to ask questions and feel confident in their care. The office atmosphere is designed to be fun, stress-free, and welcoming.

Who will I interact with during my visit?

You’ll be treated by a compassionate, knowledgeable, all-female team that brings state-of-the-art dental care with a warm, family-like touch. Their dedication ensures a caring, professional experience from the moment you arrive.

Can I prepare any paperwork ahead of time?

Yes. You can download and complete patient registration forms from the website before your first appointment. As a courtesy, we will reach out to your insurance carrier to verify coverage, helping your visit run smoother.

maintain.title: General Dentist & Teeth Cleaning in La Porte, IN | Wolf Family Dentistry
maintain.description: A healthy smile is a beautiful smile! Achieve optimal dental & oral health at Wolf Family Dentistry in La Porte, IN. Call for a general dentist & teeth cleaning appointment!

blocks.html: Maintain Your Smile
blocks.heading: Maintain Your Smile

blocks.html:
Dental Care for Your Healthiest Smile

A healthy smile is a beautiful smile. At Wolf Family Dentistry, we use the latest technology to help patients achieve and maintain optimal oral health in a comfortable manner. Our warm, friendly, knowledgeable team in La Porte, IN, is here to help you enjoy taking care of your smile!
blocks.heading: Dental Care for Your Healthiest Smile

blocks.html:
Professional Dental Cleaning

Besides regular brushing and flossing, receiving dental cleanings at least twice a year is one of the most important things you can do for your smile. During these appointments, we inspect the smile for any early signs of decay, gum disease, oral cancer, and other issues. With early detection comes a higher chance of treatment success, saving you time, money, and discomfort down the road. Using a cavitron, or an ultrasonic scaler, we make cleanings more comfortable and effective for patients. We can also give you pointers as to how you can improve your at-home hygiene regimen, so you can take a proactive approach to your dental care!
blocks.heading: Professional Dental Cleaning

blocks.html:
Night Guards & Mouthguards

We provide custom night guards to help patients who grind or clench their teeth during sleep. We also craft custom athletic mouthguards to help patients who play sports protect their teeth on the field or court!
blocks.heading: Night Guards & Mouthguards

blocks.html:
Periodontal Care

Your gums and surrounding tooth structures are just as important to your oral health as your teeth themselves. Periodontal care is essential for preventing periodontitis, or gum disease. When left untreated, periodontitis can lead to tooth loss, which is why maintaining clean, healthy gums is so vital. Our team provides periodontal maintenance, as well as scaling and root planing, which is a procedure that removes bacteria from beneath the gumline to prevent further infection.
blocks.heading: Periodontal Care

blocks.html:
Digital Radiography

Digital radiography is an important diagnostic tool and allows us to detect pathology within the teeth, gums, and jawbone that cannot be observed during a visual exam. These x-rays emit up to 90% less radiation than traditional radiography, and the images are produced instantly. We can view these images on a computer monitor with the patient, zooming in and enlarging the image to provide more visibility for diagnosing disease in the mouth.
blocks.heading: Digital Radiography

blocks.html:
Botox injections for TMJ/Bruxism

Botox, a neurotoxin protein, may help treat symptoms of temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders. You may benefit most from this treatment if other methods haven’t worked. Botox may help treat the following TMJ disorder symptoms: Jaw tension, headaches due to teeth grinding, lockjaw in cases of severe stress, Easing or even preventing the tendency to clench and grind in some cases.
blocks.heading: Botox injections for TMJ/Bruxism

restore.title: Cosmetic Dentist & Teeth Whitening in La Porte, IN | Wolf Family Dentistry
restore.description: Enhance the natural beauty of your smile with teeth whitening, tooth-colored restorations & other cosmetic dentist services. Call Wolf Family Dentistry in La Porte, IN to get started!

blocks.html: Restore Your Smile
blocks.heading: Restore Your Smile

blocks.html:
Your Dream Smile is Possible!

Enhance the natural beauty of your smile with cosmetic and restorative dentistry! At Wolf Family Dentistry, we offer a wide range of services to restore beauty, strength, and functionality to our patients’ smiles. So whether you have missing teeth, a cavity, or discoloration, we will help you craft a perfected smile you are proud to show off.
blocks.heading: Your Dream Smile is Possible!

blocks.html:
Cosmetic Dentistry

Cosmetic dentistry is the branch of dental procedures that is designed to improve the aesthetic appearance of your smile. Whether your smile has been compromised by discoloration, chips, gaps, cracks, or crookedness, cosmetic dentistry can cover these imperfections. Our team will work with you to determine your goals for your smile and help you achieve them!
blocks.heading: Cosmetic Dentistry

blocks.html:
Teeth Whitening

The shade of your smile can be impacted by several factors. Even if you brush and floss like you’re supposed to, drinking dark beverages, smoking, aging, and certain medications can cause the teeth to yellow. We offer teeth whitening to help our patients achieve a vibrantly white yet natural-looking smile they are proud to show off! Whether it’s for a special event or just to help boost your confidence in your smile, teeth whitening can help.
blocks.heading: Teeth Whitening

blocks.html:
Hybrid Denture

The Hybrid full arch dental implant bridge offers a simplified lasting solution for those in need of a full mouth reconstruction, congenital condition, or accident. Hybrid dentures offer a unique process that seamlessly blends professional care with exceptional technology and artistry to restore comfort and full dental function. Hybrid dentures transform our patient’s appearance, confidence, and quality of life. Click here to learn more.
blocks.heading: Hybrid Denture

blocks.html:
Tooth-Colored Restorations

We craft beautiful, esthetic, tooth-colored restorations, including zirconia inlays, onlays, and restoration of dental implants with custom abutments and zirconia crowns. Using a 3D scanner, we take digital impressions of teeth we are restoring. We then forward this digital information to a laboratory for fabrication of computer-generated zirconia restorations. These restorations are designed to fit comfortably and securely in the smile and are durable and long-lasting.
blocks.heading: Tooth-Colored Restorations

blocks.html:
Dentures

We create fixed-custom removable dentures, implant-retained fixed dentures, and partials to help patients replace missing teeth. Using a 3D scanner, we fabricate appliances that fit comfortably and securely in the smile.
blocks.heading: Dentures

We look forward to helping you achieve a smile you are proud of!
